prompt: I need to implement the forgot password feature. The backend has an endpoint at /api/auth/forgot-password that sends a reset email. Please implement the frontend integration with proper error handling.

assertions.name: mentions_swagger_or_controller
assertions.description: Should mention reading Swagger UI or backend Controller/DTO files
assertions.check: Output mentions Swagger UI, Controller, or DTO files from ../ctt-server

assertions.name: defines_wrapper_schema
assertions.description: Should define or reference RestApiResponseSchema wrapper
assertions.check: Output mentions RestApiResponseSchema or wrapper schema with success/message/data/timestamp

assertions.name: two_step_parsing
assertions.description: Should parse wrapper first, then extract data
assertions.check: Output shows parsing wrapper then accessing .data field

assertions.name: error_extraction_correct
assertions.description: Should extract error from error.data.code not error.error
assertions.check: Output uses error.data?.code or error.data.code, NOT error.error

assertions.name: mentions_self_test
assertions.description: Should mention calling endpoint to verify
assertions.check: Output mentions curl, Swagger 'Try it out', or actual endpoint call
